name: exploded-grinder-pareto-26.10-preview-s1-r1
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a manual coffee grinder, as an SVG. Use a hand grinder with conical burrs rather than flat burrs.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1000" height="1450" viewBox="0 0 1000 1450">
<title>Manual coffee grinder — exploded assembly</title>
<desc>A crank-operated hand grinder separated along its central shaft. The steel burr set consists of a stationary tapered ring and a rotating conical inner burr, narrow end up. Numbered leaders identify the crank, lid, shaft, hopper, outer burr, inner burr, spring, adjustment dial, and grounds cup.</desc>
